name: Mary's | 200mg The Remedy Tincture | Relax THC
description: Our Relax sublingual is thoughtfully designed for those seeking tranquility. This intoxicating THC blend features a comforting Orange-Vanilla flavor. Formulated with Myrcene, Linalool, Pinene, and Caryophyllene, this blend allows you to embrace its calming essence for your daily moments of relaxation and self-care.
